reviewNotes: Held back: the score has bars of another length (bar 4, 5), which the solfa grid does not draw. Johann Balthasar Konig's dates (1691–1758) are from our page for the tune ALLES IST AN GOTTES SEGEN (content/hymns/tunes/alles-ist-an-gottes-segen.json); CCEH's page gives only the year 1738.
